question: In November 2022, who became the 50th Chief Justice of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Justice DY Chandrachud**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Justice DY Chandrachud took oath as the 50th Chief Justice of India in November 2022.
 
• He succeeded Justice UU Lalit, who retired on November 8, 2022.
 
• Justice Chandrachud is known for his landmark judgments
